canon.silhouette: an I - a narrow upright column with a flat horizontal shoulder line and a dead-vertical pole carrying one detached rectangle above the crown
canon.reads_as: a walking rectangle under a pale flag - the one straight-edged figure in the crowd

prompt.description: A stocky armored standard-bearer in heavy plate. Oversized head in an open-faced helm with a flat top, no visor and no crest, broad blunt face. Squared pauldrons make a flat horizontal shoulder line; short thick legs with the feet close together, so the whole body reads as a narrow upright column. One hand grips a dead-straight vertical pole at the hip; the pole rises well clear above the head and carries a small plain rectangular banner of undecorated cloth, burning bright. The other hand hangs empty at the side. Boxy build, hard straight edges, everything squared off.
must_include: flat horizontal shoulder line, unbroken by collar or cloth
dead-vertical pole gripped at hip height, rising clear above the head
small rectangular banner with four straight edges, clear of the head
open face under the helm, no visor
narrow upright body, feet close together
must_avoid: swallowtail, forked, torn or curving banner edges
any device, emblem or writing on the banner
helm crest, plume, wings or horns
glow, halo, sparks or rays around any pixel
lantern, torch or bowl held in the hand
